title: In The News 68
summary: Pulse In The News from College Pulse: research, polls, and reports on American college students from the American College Student Panel.
body_markdown:
# Pulse In The News


68 posts in In The News


[How AI Is Impacting Students’ Career Choices January 29th, 2024 Partner ↗ The rise of artificial intelligence is influencing what many students want to study and pursue as a career, according to a new flash survey from Student Voice. Students also say they want to be prepared for AI and the workplace.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/life-after-college/2024/01/10/survey-college-students-thoughts-ai-and-careers)


[Students Want Career Prep in the Curriculum January 18th, 2024 Partner ↗ In new Student Voice data, two- and four-year college respondents say they want a high level of faculty and adviser involvement in their career preparation.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/life-after-college/2023/12/20/what-college-students-want-career-prep)


[Key Differences in Student Satisfaction With Career Centers January 18th, 2024 Partner ↗ Nonwhite students and online students who have engaged with their campus career centers have lower satisfaction and effectiveness rates for these services, a Student Voice survey finds.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/life-after-college/2023/12/07/survey-career-center-satisfaction-differs-race)


[Students Sound Off on Career Centers January 10th, 2024 Partner ↗ According to the newest Student Voice survey on life after college, there’s a gap between the services students say career centers should offer and what services they’re actually seeking out.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/life-after-college/2023/11/30/survey-what-college-students-want-career)


[Helping Students Prepare for Life After College December 7th, 2023 Partner ↗ Respondents to the newest Student Voice survey value passion as much as practicality in preparing for a career and expect moderate to high levels of support from professors and academic advisers in this area.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/life-after-college/2023/11/21/survey-college-students-talk-career-preparation?utm_source=hootsuite&utm_medium=&utm_term=&utm_content=&utm_campaign=)


[Student College Experience Survey: The Top 10 Takeaways November 27th, 2023 Partner ↗ Major findings from our Student Voice survey on the college experience, from orientation to campus life, reveal major gaps in student involvement levels.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/11/10/college-experience-survey-10-takeaways)


[Getting More Students Involved November 14th, 2023 Partner ↗ A fresh Student Voice survey finds that more than half of students who aren’t engaged in campus life beyond the classroom are dissatisfied, that campus involvement is linked to ease in making friends, and more.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/11/03/survey-getting-more-college-students-involved)


[Campus Involvement: The Tech Connection November 7th, 2023 Partner ↗ Some students say they lack awareness of campus events and activities, according to new survey findings. Many want a comprehensive campus events calendar and see technology as a way to enhance campus involvement.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/10/13/why-so-many-students-want-campus-events-calendar)


[So Little Time, Not Enough Help With Time Management? November 2nd, 2023 Partner ↗ Students are interested in a variety of offerings for help with time management, according to a survey on the college experience. High on the list are comprehensive syllabi, help with overall scheduling and social supports.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/10/05/survey-students-want-help-time-management)


[Survey: Inequities in Student Involvement November 2nd, 2023 Partner ↗ Student Voice data from College Pulse and Inside Higher Ed reveal disparities in who’s participating in campus life outside the classroom — and opportunities for closing these gaps.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/09/22/survey-barriers-college-students-campus)


[Student Views on the College Experience August 24th, 2023 Partner ↗ Learn what boosts and limits student participation in campus extracurriculars and events in this preview of findings from the newest Student Voice survey.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/college-experience/2023/08/21/student-assessments-their-college-experience?utm_source=hootsuite&utm_medium=&utm_term=&utm_content=&utm_campaign=)


[Student Health and Wellness Survey: The Top 10 Takeaways August 9th, 2023 Partner ↗ Major findings from our Student Voice survey on health and wellness link stress to decreased academic performance, poorer mental health, and more.](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/student-success/health-wellness/2023/08/07/10-takeaways-college-student-health-and-wellness)
